title: Alex Eala to play at Asian Games regardless of WTA decision, says Philta

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Alex Eala will compete for the Philippines at the Asian Games 2026 in Japan regardless of the outcome of Philta’s pending request for a waiver from the WTA, the national tennis federation said. “Alex will definitely play at the Asian Games regardless of the WTA decision,” Philta Executive Director Tonette Mendoza said in a press release. READ: Alex Eala’s road to Asian Games—and what she’ll miss to represent PH Philta previously asked the WTA not to penalize Eala for skipping the China Open, a mandatory WTA 1000 event, to represent the Philippines at the Asian Games.
